reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: New Mexico
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant based on their ancestry?
*/

% -----------------------
% Metadata (non-legal)
% -----------------------

state(new_mexico).
focus_year(2021).

% -----------------------
% Scenario facts
% -----------------------

% People and roles
person(landlord_alice).
person(tenant_bob).

landlord(landlord_alice).
tenant(tenant_bob).

% Housing unit / accommodation
housing_accommodation(apt1).

% A landlord-tenant relationship exists for the unit
rental_relationship(landlord_alice, tenant_bob, apt1).

% Action at issue: eviction
action(landlord_alice, evict, tenant_bob, apt1).

% Motivation: based on ancestry
reason_for_action(landlord_alice, evict, tenant_bob, apt1, ancestry).

/* scenario_statement/0
   Succeeds when the question's factual statement (as encoded) is satisfied:
   a landlord evicts a tenant, and the reason is the tenant's ancestry.
*/
scenario_statement :-
    state(new_mexico),
    focus_year(2021),
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    housing_accommodation(Housing),
    rental_relationship(Landlord, Tenant, Housing),
    action(Landlord, evict, Tenant, Housing),
    reason_for_action(Landlord, evict, Tenant, Housing, ancestry).

% -----------------------
% Statute translation
% -----------------------

/* protected_trait_housing/1
   NM Stat  28-1-7(G) (2021) protected bases for housing discrimination.
   (List includes the traits explicitly named in Subsection G.)
*/
protected_trait_housing(race).
protected_trait_housing(religion).
protected_trait_housing(color).
protected_trait_housing(national_origin).
protected_trait_housing(ancestry).
protected_trait_housing(sex).
protected_trait_housing(sexual_orientation).
protected_trait_housing(gender_identity).
protected_trait_housing(pregnancy_childbirth_or_related_condition).
protected_trait_housing(spousal_affiliation).
protected_trait_housing(physical_or_mental_handicap).

/* trait_ok_for_housing/3
   NM Stat  28-1-7(G)(2) proviso:
   discrimination is prohibited for physical/mental handicap only when the handicap
   is unrelated to ability to acquire/rent/maintain the housing.
   For other protected traits, the proviso does not apply.
*/
trait_ok_for_housing(Person, Housing, physical_or_mental_handicap) :-
    handicap_unrelated_to_ability(Person, Housing).
trait_ok_for_housing(_Person, _Housing, Trait) :-
    Trait \= physical_or_mental_handicap.

/* action_counts_as_terms_conditions_discrimination/1
   NM Stat  28-1-7(G)(2) prohibits discrimination in "terms, conditions or privileges"
   of the rental/lease. Eviction is modeled here as an adverse change/termination of
   the lease terms/privileges (i.e., denial of continued tenancy).
*/
action_counts_as_terms_conditions_discrimination(evict).

/* nm_stat_28_1_7_g2_unlawful_discrimination/4
   NM Stat  28-1-7(G)(2) (2021):
   Unlawful for any person to discriminate against any person in terms/conditions/privileges
   of the rental/lease of a housing accommodation because of protected trait (incl. ancestry),
   subject to the handicap proviso.
*/
nm_stat_28_1_7_g2_unlawful_discrimination(Actor, Target, Housing, Trait) :-
    action(Actor, Act, Target, Housing),
    action_counts_as_terms_conditions_discrimination(Act),
    reason_for_action(Actor, Act, Target, Housing, Trait),
    protected_trait_housing(Trait),
    trait_ok_for_housing(Target, Housing, Trait).

/* unlawful_eviction_based_on_ancestry/0
   Helper that ties the scenario to the statute: eviction based on ancestry is unlawful.
*/
unlawful_eviction_based_on_ancestry :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    housing_accommodation(Housing),
    nm_stat_28_1_7_g2_unlawful_discrimination(Landlord, Tenant, Housing, ancestry).

% -----------------------
% Answer derivation (must be deterministic)
% -----------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    unlawful_eviction_based_on_ancestry,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% -----------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% -----------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant based on their ancestry?
